description: A close vignette of a bedroom nightstand zone, camera at seated height shooting at a level angle with a normal lens capturing the left third of the bed and the wall-mounted floating nightstand. The entire wall surface is clad in medium-toned light oak wood paneling with a clean vertical grain — continuous from floor to the slatted wooden screen element near the ceiling. The upper portion of the back wall transitions into a slatted wood screen panel with rectangular cutouts, backlit by a warm amber linear glow that filters through the slats and creates a honeyed architectural accent. The floating nightstand is a minimal shelf with a single drawer in matching light oak, wall-mounted at bedside height. On its surface sit a glass bud vase holding a small leafy green branch and a compact matte black cylindrical object — spare and intentional. Matte black double electrical outlets are mounted flush on the paneling. The bed has a wide, low upholstered headboard in light gray linen, dressed with cream and white ruffled pillowcases. The bedding is a soft warm ivory. A warm directional glow washes down from the upper left onto the nightstand surface, spotlighting the vase and casting a soft circular pool of amber light on the wood. The palette is entirely warm and wood-toned with matte black accents — a restrained modern Japanese aesthetic.
